title: Joint Thoracic Oncology Research Unit of LYon: Lung cancerS DatabaSE (ULYSSE)
official: Prospective Longitudinal Cohort Associated to Blood Collection, Pathological Samples Collection, and Radiological and Pathological Imaging Collection
summary: Prospective longitudinal cohort associated to blood collection, pathological samples collection, and radiological and pathological imaging collection.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient treated for a thoracic cancer in the Lyon University Hospital: non-small cell lung cancer, small cell lung cancer, mesothelioma…
* Diagnosis can be done:

  * By cytology or pathologic assessment
  * Or by multidisciplinary team meeting decision:

    * Irradiation without morpho-metabolic sampling
    * Treatment without sampling based on non-invasive molecular data

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Refusal to participate

For optional blood sampling :

* \< 30 kg for blood collection
* No blood sampling schedule for care
